2022 Std p294-295: 140.10(a) scope = newly constructed building types in Table 140.10-A (or 80 pct mixed occupancy); Eq 140.10-A kWPVdc = (CFA x A)/1000, A in W/ft2 by building type and CZ; size is smaller of Eq or SARA x 14 W/ft2; exceptions match intent

2022 Std p296: Eq 140.10-B is kWhbatt = kWPVdc x B / D^0.5 (D = rated AC to AC round-trip efficiency), kWhbatt defined as rated useable energy capacity; Eq 140.10-C kWbatt = kWPVdc x C. Seed formula BKWH = kW_PVdc*B omits the /sqrt(D) term. Also 2025 Std p365-366 (CEC-400-2025-010-F) uses kWhbatt = (CFA x B)/(1000 x C^0.5) and kWbatt = kWhbatt/4, so the shared 2022/2025 formulas do not match 2025 either

2022 Std p339: 150.1(c)14 Photovoltaic requirements under 150.1 for single-family residential buildings, Eq 150.1-C kWPV = (CFA x A)/1000 + (NDU x B); residential only, no battery kWh minimum; matches title and intent (seed says low-rise/single-family, 2022 text says single-family)
